?? MEENGLE - COOKIE POLICY

Last Updated: January 2024

1. WHAT ARE COOKIES?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, phone, tablet) when you visit a website. They help websites recognize you, remember your preferences, and track your activity.

2. WHY DOES MEENGLE USE COOKIES?

MEENGLE uses cookies for the following purposes:

  • Essential/Functional: Keep you logged in, maintain your session, enable features
  • Analytical: Understand how users interact with MEENGLE (Google Analytics)
  • Preference: Remember your settings, language, theme
  • Marketing: Track conversion goals and user journeys

3. TYPES OF COOKIES MEENGLE USES

Cookie Name Type Purpose Duration
session_id Essential Maintain your login session Session (expires on logout)
auth_token Essential Authentication token for API requests 30 days
user_preferences Functional Remember your settings and preferences 1 year
_ga Analytical Google Analytics tracking 2 years
_gid Analytical Google Analytics session tracking 24 hours
language_preference Functional Remember your language choice 1 year
theme_preference Functional Remember light/dark theme choice 1 year

4. THIRD-PARTY COOKIES

MEENGLE uses third-party services that may set their own cookies:

  • Google Analytics: Tracks website usage and user behavior
  • Stripe: Processes payments securely
  • Socket.IO: Enables real-time messaging

5. MANAGING COOKIES

You can control cookies through your browser settings:

  • Chrome: Settings ? Privacy and security ? Cookies and other site data
  • Firefox: Preferences ? Privacy & Security ? Cookies and Site Data
  • Safari: Preferences ? Privacy ? Cookies and website data
  • Edge: Settings ? Privacy, search, and services ? Clear browsing data

6. DISABLING COOKIES

You can disable cookies, but this may affect MEENGLE's functionality:

  • You may be logged out automatically
  • Your preferences won't be saved
  • Some features may not work properly
  • We won't be able to personalize your experience

7. DO NOT TRACK (DNT)

Some browsers include a "Do Not Track" feature. MEENGLE respects DNT signals and will not set analytical cookies if DNT is enabled.

8. CONSENT

When you first visit MEENGLE, you'll see a cookie consent banner. By accepting:

  • You consent to all cookies listed in Section 3
  • You can withdraw consent anytime in settings
  • Essential cookies are used regardless of consent

9. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

We may update this Cookie Policy. Changes become effective when posted. We'll notify you of significant changes via email or in-app notification.

10. CONTACT US

Questions about cookies? Contact: privacy@meengle.com
